system.senses: Spots suspicious movement within about 6 squares in line of sight.
system.passive: Asleep ~70% of the time. When awake, paying complete attention.
system.escalation: Alert 3, ears rotate. Alert 5, moves toward the sound. Alert 7, hunting.
system.weakness: Shiny objects (Difficulty 1 to redirect), sudden loud noises in the opposite direction, and cucumbers. The ST may rule a cucumber a Difficulty 0 distraction if the crew somehow produced one.
system.biography:
“The Reason We Can't Have Nice Heists.”

Asleep roughly seventy percent of the time. The other thirty percent, it is the single most attentive being in the location — and it fears nothing.
